work.title: What I do these days
body: I'm a Senior UI/UX Designer and Assistant Creative Director at Praxxys Solutions, where I've been since 2022. Most days I'm somewhere between a client call, a Figma file and a developer's desk, making sure what we promised is what gets built.
I lead projects from the first requirements meeting to handover and QA, keep our design system in shape, and help the juniors on the team find their footing.

talk.title: I also get to talk about it
body: Draft: I was a guest speaker at LVCC ICT Week, back at the school where I studied. A few words here about the topic, the students, and what it felt like to stand on the other side of the room.
